header: Sections and their pages, two levels deep
lead: Four to sixty entries, set in columns. An entry without a link starts a section, and the pages below it are indented under that heading.
note: Editors keep this list by hand; it is not generated from the page tree. A generated sitemap shows pages nobody meant to list and loses sections when they are renamed.

links.title: Sections flow without breaks
links.description: With 50 entries, a forced break leaves half the band empty

links.title: A heading never ends a column
The headings are real h3 elements
